text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити suffers a loss to Tamamo
Cross. Cheers
admiring Тамамо Кросс's
strength resound
throughout the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It fills Голд Сити with envy and
despondency. No
one seems to discuss
her accomplishments,
convincing her
that no matter how much she runs,
her
skill will never be recognized.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс is angered by Голд Сити's
gutless
performance and asks her why
she runs in the first
place, but Голд Сити
can't find an answer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When she talks to me, she quietly
concedes that
nothing she does will ever
change her reputation.
But when asked if
she would stop running, she
does
nothing to affirm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unconvinced that she truly wants to give
up, I
decide to register her for the Osaka
Hai, with my
eyes now set on the Senior
Spring Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
